integrity: The stated claim is established by an analytic finite-pattern partition for every integer ensemble size at least two; the included exact-rational finite enumeration is supplementary rather than an infinite-parameter certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar three-row projected Gram family, fixed finite ensemble size, expected Bernoulli sampling budget one, same-ensemble ordinary-least-squares weight without clipping, and pre-damping forward estimate. Does not assert a bound or failure for regularized or subsequently damped inverse sketches or FEM solution error. The full historical priority of the specific finite-sample limit is not independently established.
title: A sharp finite-ensemble risk singularity for positive Bernoulli Gram control variates
